source.author: verg
source.text: Ille dies primus leti primusque malorum causa fuit; neque enim specie famave movetur, nec iam furtivum Dido meditatur amorem:
source.text_original: Ille dies primus leti primusque malorum / causa fuit; neque enim specie famave movetur, / nec iam furtivum Dido meditatur amorem: /
source.text_english: That day was the first cause of death and the first of evils; for Dido is moved no longer by his appearance or his reputation, nor does she now ponder a secret love.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: ille dies primus leti primusque malorum causa fuit: quae et ipsis et orbi terrarum acciderunt.
reuse.text_original: ille dies primus leti primusque malorum causa fuit: quae et ipsis et orbi terrarum acciderunt.
reuse.text_english: That day was the first of death and the first cause of evils: these things happened both to them and to the whole world.
